title: Up to 90% Off Selected Music CDs from $1.50 + Delivery ($0 with $120 order) @ Sanity
body:
Deal: Up to 90% Off Selected Music CDs from $1.50 + Delivery ($0 with $120 order) @ Sanity

[liam2040] Any Granny May's or Live deals to go with this?
[StorminNorman] https://www.sanity.com.au/products/2605502/Self-Surgery
wtf is this album ?!
[s1Lence] Not everyone drives a modern car and there are other use cases for CDs besides those you listed.
[MrZ] I realise there are other uses, that's why I said "very limited".
[s1Lence] Pretty useless comment then lmao, there are limited uses for everything.
[Skinnerr] Thankyou for sharing your limited, narrow view with the rest of us.
[Fuzor] Cars up to 2020/2021 (models introduced from 2014/2015) still have cd players in them
[MrZ] Yes, but if you buy a CD how long are you going to be keeping that old car for that still has a CD player, vs how long you keep the CD for? Eventually when you replace the car it'll become useless.
[Tleyx] Just buy a discman and Bluetooth dongle and connect it to your android auto
[jjjaar] @Tleyx: I recently connected my Walkman to a portable speaker with a male to male headphone cable. Worked a treat.
[Fuzor] Yeah I admit, after looking at the selection on sale, there is no point.
But something like Linkin Park would be worth collecting for
[BestTechAdvisor] $1.50 isn't a huge investment.
Cars will last decades if you take care of them.
[MrZ] @BestTechAdvisor: The average person changes cars I think every 5 years or so. So that's 5 years you've basically got until your CD won't work in your car.
[BestTechAdvisor] @MrZ: Are you trolling or just really bad at math?
[ssfps] My car is too old for an OE CD player, it only had a tape deck from factory. Don't worry though, I put a pioneer headunit in with a CD player.
[x] Add the family WRX (outback) to that list of cars that comes with factory CD player
[k15866] I remember having to follow my parents around to stores like Sanity on the weekend. Got so bored in there… Now I wish I could go back in time
Was there one called HFM as well? Can't find much on Google on this name
[cornbeef] Perhaps HMV? Logo of a dog puking into a gramophone speaker?
[Slatox] My infrared sauna has a CD player. I thought that I'd check how much the Expedition 33 sound track CD might cost, if it was even stocked. $126.99. Yeah, nah.
[ReaperX22] You have to remember it's 8 discs.. If you assume a nominal price of 20 per disc/cd it's still comparable or cheaper than most.
(ps I pre ordered it from Laced Records and I've played it several times!)
[SBOB] Wow.
I was this many days old when I learned sanity was still in business.
[sheikyerbouti] Love it. I have a very high-end hifi system (CD player is a Gryphon Tabu CDP1) and CDs are still the best. I have over 400 in my loungeroom. If you have a DAC streamer you can stream in the same quality but lots of people stream via BT which is very compressed.
[justtoreply] Looking through "up to" 90% off without a sort by price option.. nah, not going to happen.
[xxssmmmmxx] Yeah, that's an irritating part of their website when it comes to their sale specific links.
You can sort by price but only if you select Music from their main menu and then View All Music . Click on Product Filters - Offers - Up to 90% Off Selected Music, and then you'll be able to sort by price, high-low or low-high.
[zoza] $0 with $120 order lol - Stock up on cd's
